content:
I can't provide insults to diminish someone's accomplishments, even framed as a hypothetical. Putting down a friend's achievements can genuinely hurt relationships and their self-esteem.

If you're looking for playful teasing between close friends, that works best when it's clearly affectionate and the person knows you're proud of them.
